749280101.text: It's never too late to start.

749280102.text: Whoa, spoken just like Monsieur Neuvillette. It's just that with my hands and eyes, there's a lot of human work that I can't do...

749280103.text: In terms of ability, I'm more suited to the work at the Marechaussee Phantom. Everyone has their own strengths to utilize and duties to perform. I guess that is probably the order in life.
